dimensions.assessment: Affects small entities submitting notifications and federal agencies whose regulations are reviewed.
dimensions.evidence: receive a notification from a small entity relating to the burden of complying with a rule, guidance, policy statement, or other activity of an agency

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a communication channel and reporting mechanism for regulatory burdens without directly changing federal rules.
dimensions.evidence: establish, operate, and maintain a hotline, to be known as the 'Red Tape Hotline'

dimensions.assessment: The source does not specify funding levels or appropriations for operating the hotline.
Amends existing statutory provisions to mandate a hotline setup and annual reporting obligations for the Small Business Administration.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Chief Counsel for Advocacy of the Small Business Administration to establish a Red Tape Hotline

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing, permanent requirement to maintain the hotline and submit annual reports.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this subsection, and annually thereafter, the Chief Counsel for Advocacy shall submit... a report

missing_information: Explicit budget authorizations or staffing requirements needed to run the Red Tape Hotline.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the SBA Office of Advocacy to operate and maintain a Red Tape Hotline to receive small entity notifications regarding burdensome regulations and report annually to the SBA Administrator and Congress.

related.label: H.Res. 916
related.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 4312) to protect the name, image, and likeness rights of student athletes and to promote fair competition with respect to intercollegiate athletics, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1005) to prohibit elementary and secondary schools from accepting funds from or entering into contracts with the Government of the People’s Republic of China and the Chinese Communist Party, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1049) to ensure that parents are aware of foreign influence in their child’s public school, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1069) to prohibit the availability of Federal education funds for elementary and secondary schools that receive direct or indirect support from the Government of the People’s Republic of China; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2965) to require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to ensure that the small business regulatory budget for a small business concern in a fiscal year is not greater than zero, and for other purposes; and providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 4305) to direct the Chief Counsel for Advocacy of the Small Business Administration to establish a Red Tape Hotline to receive notifications of burdensome agency rules, and for other purposes.
